status: Completed light read-only QA of all24 returned structures; none is MD-ready as exported.
scope: Exact structures and metrics were resolved through each results/index.jsonl. No inputs edited; no installations, minimization, force-field evaluation, heavy computation, or PAE loading.

nintedanib_status.reason: Nintedanib was reported as provider-filtered in these screening jobs and is absent from both result indices. It appears as an input reference ligand, which is not a returned candidate complex.
nintedanib_status.interpretation: Filtered/absent is not evidence of nonbinding. No nintedanib MD starting complex is available from these jobs.

confidence_limits: All atom_site B_iso_or_equiv fields equal100.000; they cannot be treated as residue pLDDT or used for local-confidence coloring.
No local ma_qa_metric records were found. Metrics.json provides global structure/binding/complex confidence values only.
PAE files were not loaded. Motif/pocket/insert local confidence is therefore unavailable in this audit.
chemistry_limits: Element counts, names, CIF topology endpoints and input descriptor agreement were checked for all ligands.
Matching SMILES/descriptors does not independently verify coordinate stereochemistry. All coordinate_stereochemistry_independently_verified flags are false.
Hydrogen, protonation/tautomer and force-field preparation are still required.

Nerandomilast canonical descriptor may use charge-separated sulfoxide [O-][S@+] while the input descriptor uses S=O; this is a representation difference requiring chemistry-aware comparison, not automatic identity failure.
geometry_limits: Distances are geometric proximities, not assigned hydrogen bonds; donor/acceptor state and angles were not independently validated.

No sub-2 A protein-ligand heavy-atom overlaps and no ligand bonds above2 A were found. This severe-overlap screen does not establish clash-free packing; atom-specific van der Waals contacts, force-field energetics and stereochemical validation were not assessed.
Do not connect protein fragment endpoints across omitted residues; internal crop boundary distances reach tens of angstroms.
3C7Q is a KDR/VEGFR2 homolog reference, not target-specific validation.
No affinity, inhibition, therapeutic direction, hepatoprotection, or liver-fibrosis efficacy is established by these predictions.
